title: GRAML: Graph-Grounded Reasoning and Multi-Task Learning for LLM-Based Software Vulnerability Detection
title_zh: GRAML：基于图证据的推理与多任务学习在大型语言模型软件漏洞检测中的应用

paragraphs.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been widely applied to software vulnerability detection. However, their performance is often limited by insufficient use of control-flow and data-flow information. In this paper, we propose GRAML, a framework that combines graph evidence, vulnerability description generation, and multi-task training. GRAML first performs static analysis on C/C++ programs to extract critical source lines and typed line relations as structural evidence. It then uses this evidence to guide GPT-5 through the Tree-of-Thought-guided Vulnerability Reasoning (ToT-VR) process and generate vulnerability descriptions. These descriptions are further combined with Detection, Localization, and Assessment samples to build a unified four-task training dataset. We evaluate GRAML on an in-distribution (ID) test set and six out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets. The results show that GRAML achieves average F1 scores ranging from 66.67% to 68.70%, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines by up to 30.92%. Ablation experiments further show that ToT-VR and graph-guided vulnerability descriptions improve detection performance compared with standard Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning and raw Code Property Graph (CPG) serializations. These findings provide practical guidance for building more reliable and secure software engineering systems with large language models.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）已被广泛应用于软件漏洞检测。 然而，其性能常常受到控制流和数据流信息利用不足的限制。 在本文中，我们提出了 GRAML——一个结合了图证据、漏洞描述生成和多任务训练的框架。 GRAML 首先对 C/C++ 程序进行静态分析，提取关键源代码行和带类型的行关系作为结构证据。 随后，它利用这些证据通过“思维树引导的漏洞推理”（ToT-VR）过程指导 GPT-5 生成漏洞描述。 这些描述进一步与检测、定位和评估样本结合，构建了一个统一的四任务训练数据集。 我们在一个分布内（ID）测试集和六个分布外（OOD）数据集上对 GRAML 进行了评估。 结果表明，GRAML 的平均 F1 分数在 66.67% 到 68.70% 之间，比当前最先进的基线模型最高提升了 30.92%。 消融实验进一步表明，与标准的“思维链”（CoT）推理和原始代码属性图（CPG）序列化相比，ToT-VR 和图引导的漏洞描述能够提升检测性能。 这些发现为利用大型语言模型构建更可靠、更安全的软件工程系统提供了实用指导。

paragraphs.en: With the rapid advancement of software engineering, LLMs have shown considerable promise in automating software vulnerability detection [ 1 ] . By learning from large volumes of source code and historical vulnerability samples, LLMs can capture general programming patterns and security-related semantics, enabling them to identify potential vulnerability patterns in complex codebases. These capabilities allow LLM-based approaches to reduce manual rule design and feature engineering, making them attractive for scalable vulnerability detection [ 2 ] . Recent studies further show that LLMs have been used in different vulnerability analysis settings, including software security surveys [ 3 ] , retrieval-based vulnerability detection [ 4 ] , and inter-procedural semantic analysis [ 5 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 随着软件工程技术的快速发展，大型语言模型（LLM）在自动化软件漏洞检测方面展现出巨大潜力 [ 1 ] 。 通过从海量源代码和历史漏洞样本中学习，LLM 能够捕捉通用的编程模式和安全相关的语义，从而在复杂的代码库中识别潜在的漏洞模式。 这些能力使得基于 LLM 的方法能够减少手动设计规则和特征工程的工作量，因此成为可扩展的漏洞检测方案中的热门选择 [ 2 ] 。 近期的研究进一步表明，LLM 已被应用于多种漏洞分析场景，包括软件安全综述 [ 3 ] 、基于检索的漏洞检测 [ 4 ] 以及跨过程语义分析 [ 5 ] 。

paragraphs.en: However, existing LLMs mainly understand source code from tokens and labels, but make limited use of control-flow and data-flow information [ 6 , 7 ] . As a result, they may miss how a vulnerability moves through the code from source to sink, making it difficult to identify its root cause [ 8 ] . This weakness can lead to both false positives, where benign code is misclassified as vulnerable, and false negatives, where real vulnerabilities are missed [ 9 ] . Existing studies have therefore explored additional program contexts and structural signals beyond binary labels, including vulnerability interpretation for LLM-based detection [ 10 ] , CPG-guided context construction [ 11 ] , and the fusion of language models and GNNs for joint semantic and structural modeling [ 12 ] . Fine-grained property graph representations [ 13 ] and augmented Program Dependence Graph (PDG)-based representations [ 14 ] have also been used to preserve control-flow, data-flow, and semantic information in vulnerability detection. Nevertheless, how to extract and organize these structural relations into an effective context for downstream vulnerability reasoning remains an open problem.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，现有的大型语言模型（LLM）主要通过词元和标签来理解源代码，但对控制流和数据流信息的利用却十分有限 [ 6 , 7 ] 。 因此，它们可能会忽略漏洞从源点传播到汇点的过程，从而难以识别其根本原因 [ 8 ] 。 这种缺陷可能导致两种错误：将良性代码误判为存在漏洞的假阳性，以及漏检真实漏洞的假阴性 [ 9 ] 。 因此，现有研究已探索了超越二元标签的额外程序上下文和结构信号，包括用于基于 LLM 检测的漏洞解释 [ 10 ] 、由 CPG 引导的上下文构建 [ 11 ] ，以及将语言模型与 GNN 融合以实现联合语义和结构建模的方法 [ 12 ] 。 精细的属性图表示 [ 13 ] 以及增强型程序依赖图（PDG）表示 [ 14 ] 也被用于在漏洞检测中保留控制流、数据流和语义信息。 尽管如此，如何将这些结构关系提取并组织成有效的上下文，以支持下游的漏洞推理，仍然是一个尚未解决的问题。

paragraphs.en: To address this challenge, we propose GRAML, a framework that integrates graph-based program information into LLM-based vulnerability detection. GRAML consists of graph evidence extraction, vulnerability description generation, and multi-task fine-tuning. During training data construction, we use Joern [ 15 ] to build Code Property Graphs (CPGs) [ 16 ] . We align graph nodes with physical source lines and retain data dependence, control dependence, and control flow relations. Starting from known vulnerable lines obtained from patch information or CVE records, GRAML applies reliability-aware propagation to select critical lines and typed line relations. The resulting graph evidence is then used to support vulnerability description generation.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们提出了 GRAML——一个将基于图的程序信息整合到基于 LLM 的漏洞检测中的框架。 GRAML 包括图证据提取、漏洞描述生成和多任务微调三个部分。 在训练数据构建过程中，我们使用 Joern [ 15 ] 来构建代码属性图（CPGs）[ 16 ]。 我们将图节点与实际的源代码行对齐，并保留了数据依赖、控制依赖和控制流关系。 从通过补丁信息或 CVE 记录获取的已知漏洞行出发，GRAML 应用可靠性感知传播机制来选择关键行和有类型的行关系。 随后，所得到的图证据被用于支持漏洞描述的生成。

paragraphs.en: Based on the extracted evidence, we design ToT-VR to generate vulnerability descriptions with GPT-5 [ 17 ] . The reasoning process uses the source code and available CVE information together with the selected critical lines and graph relations. It first constructs multiple candidate analyses. These candidates are then pruned, refined, and checked against the available evidence. The final output describes the vulnerability cause, the affected code regions, and the potential security consequences.
paragraphs.zh: 基于提取出的证据，我们设计了 ToT-VR，利用 GPT-5 [ 17 ] 生成漏洞描述。 推理过程同时使用了源代码、可用的 CVE 信息，以及选定的关键代码行和图关系。 它首先构建多个候选分析结果。 随后，这些候选结果会被筛选、优化，并与可用证据进行核对。 最终输出描述了漏洞原因、受影响的代码区域以及潜在的安全影响。

paragraphs.en: We then construct a training dataset using BigVul [ 18 ] , DiverseVul [ 19 ] , and newly collected CVE samples reported between 2019 and 2026. The dataset contains four tasks, namely Detection, Description, Localization, and Assessment. Detection determines whether the input code is vulnerable. Description explains the vulnerability cause, Localization identifies the affected code lines, and Assessment estimates the vulnerability severity. The descriptions generated by ToT-VR are used for the Description task. All four tasks are combined to train the models jointly.
paragraphs.zh: 接着，我们使用 BigVul [ 18 ]、DiverseVul [ 19 ] 以及 2019 年至 2026 年间新收集的 CVE 样本来构建一个训练数据集。 该数据集包含四个任务，即检测、描述、定位和评估。 检测任务用于判断输入代码是否存在漏洞。 描述任务解释漏洞成因，定位任务识别受影响的代码行，评估任务则估算漏洞的严重程度。 ToT-VR 生成的描述被用于描述任务。 所有四个任务被结合使用以联合训练模型。

paragraphs.en: Using this multi-task dataset, we fine-tune CodeLlama, Mistral, DeepSeek, and Qwen in the GRAML framework. After fine-tuning, each model requires only source code during inference and performs the Detection task without graph evidence, vulnerable-line annotations, or CVE descriptions. We evaluate the four models on the in-distribution (ID) test set and six out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets. The experimental results show that their average F1 scores range from 66.67% to 68.70%, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines by up to 30.92%. Although these models use 6.7B–7B parameter backbones, they achieve higher average F1 scores than the larger general-purpose LLMs included in our evaluation. To provide a fair comparison with VulLLM [ 10 ] , we replace GPT-5 with GPT-4 in GRAML while keeping the remaining settings unchanged. Under this setting, all four GRAML models achieve higher average F1 scores than the two VulLLM models. We further compare ToT-VR with standard Chain-of-Thought (CoT) and examine how graph evidence and its representation affect detection performance. We also evaluate model robustness under code transformations that preserve program behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用这个多任务数据集，在 GRAML 框架中对 CodeLlama、Mistral、DeepSeek 和 Qwen 进行微调。 微调后，每个模型在推理时仅需源代码，即可执行检测任务，而无需图证据、易受攻击行注释或 CVE 描述。 我们在分布内（ID）测试集和六个分布外（OOD）数据集上评估了这四个模型。 实验结果表明，它们的平均 F1 分数在 66.67% 到 68.70% 之间，比当前最先进的基线模型高出最多 30.92%。 尽管这些模型使用的是 67 亿至 70 亿参数的基础模型，但它们实现的平均 F1 分数仍高于我们评估中较大的通用大型语言模型。 为了与 VulLLM [ 10 ] 进行公平比较，我们在 GRAML 中将 GPT-5 替换为 GPT-4，同时保持其余设置不变。 在此设置下，所有四个 GRAML 模型实现的平均 F1 分数均高于两个 VulLLM 模型。 我们进一步将 ToT-VR 与标准的思维链（CoT）方法进行比较，并考察图证据及其表示形式如何影响检测性能。 我们还评估了模型在保持程序行为不变的代码变换下的鲁棒性。

paragraphs.en: We propose GRAML, a framework that integrates graph-structured program analysis with multi-task training to enhance the vulnerability detection performance of LLMs. The overview of GRAML is illustrated in Figure 1 . The framework consists of four sequential modules, including (1) Graph-Structured Context Extraction . This module uses Joern to construct CPGs from the source code. It then identifies critical lines based on the vulnerable lines and extracts their structural dependencies to build graph-structured contexts (Section II-B );(2) Structured Vulnerability Description Generation , which combines the graph-structured contexts, source code, and CVE descriptions in a ToT-VR process to generate structured vulnerability description (Section II-C ); (3) Multi-Task Fine-Tuning , which utilizes the extracted information from previous steps to train LLMs with four tasks, including vulnerability detection, description, localization, and assessment (Section II-D ); and (4) Vulnerability Inference , which applies the fine-tuned LLMs to detect vulnerabilities and evaluate their detection performance (Section II-E ).

paragraphs.en: The graph-structured context serves only as an intermediate representation for generating vulnerability descriptions. It is not directly included in the input to the fine-tuned LLM. As illustrated in Figure 2 , the extraction process comprises six components. In Step 1, the source-code function is indexed by its physical line numbers, and the vulnerable lines are marked. In Step 2, a binary mask and a line-aligned CPG are generated. In Step 3, the Data Dependence Graph (DDG), Control Dependence Graph (CDG), and Control Flow Graph (CFG) relations extracted from the CPG are represented by three relation-specific matrices. In Step 4, these matrices are fused into a weighted matrix and normalized into a structural relation matrix. In Step 5, the normalized matrix is used to select critical contextual lines related to the vulnerable lines. Finally, Step 6 retains the selected lines and their directed relations as the graph-structured context. The following paragraphs describe each step in detail.

paragraphs.en: Mask and CPG Generation. Given a function with N N physical lines, we first construct a binary mask M ∈ { 0 , 1 } N M\in\{0,1\}^{N} . We set M i = 1 M_{i}=1 for a non-empty and non-comment line and M i = 0 M_{i}=0 otherwise. We then use Joern to construct a CPG from the source code and map its nodes to the corresponding physical source lines. The CPG provides three types of directed line-level relations, namely the Data Dependence Graph ( DDG ), Control Dependence Graph ( CDG ), and Control Flow Graph ( CFG ) relations. The DDG relations, represented by REACHING_DEF edges, describe how definitions of variables reach their subsequent uses. The CDG relations, represented by CDG edges, describe how the execution of statements depends on control conditions. The CFG relations, represented by CFG edges, describe the possible execution order between statements. These relations provide the structural information used to construct the subsequent relation matrices.

paragraphs.en: Tree of Thoughts (ToT) [ 20 ] extends conventional CoT reasoning by exploring multiple candidate reasoning paths and selecting the most promising ones through intermediate evaluation. We use GPT-5 to perform structured vulnerability reasoning and propose a Tree-of-Thought-guided Vulnerability Reasoning (ToT-VR) mechanism for generating vulnerability descriptions. In ToT-VR, GPT-5 receives the source code and up to 20 critical lines as initial structural evidence. The selected vulnerable lines and typed line relations are then introduced during branch refinement, and the official CVE description is provided during branch verification. This evidence guides multi-branch reasoning, but it is not directly serialized into the downstream fine-tuning input. Each branch corresponds to a candidate vulnerability interpretation that focuses on a trigger point, dependency path, or causal explanation. The process proceeds stage by stage. Figure 3 presents the overall workflow, and Table I tracks a running example through the stages. The remainder of this subsection describes each stage in turn.
paragraphs.zh: 思维树（ToT）[20] 通过探索多个候选推理路径，并借助中间评估选择最有希望的路径，从而扩展了传统的 CoT 推理方法。 我们使用 GPT-5 执行结构化漏洞推理，并提出了一种由思维树引导的漏洞推理机制（ToT-VR），用于生成漏洞描述。 在 ToT-VR 中，GPT-5 接收源代码以及最多 20 行关键代码作为初始结构证据。 随后，在分支细化阶段会引入已选中的脆弱代码行和类型化的行间关系，并在分支验证阶段提供官方的 CVE 描述。 这些证据为多分支推理提供指导，但不会直接序列化为下游微调的输入。 每个分支对应一种候选的漏洞解释，重点关注某个触发点、依赖路径或因果解释。 该过程分阶段进行。 图 3 展示了整体工作流程，表 I 则通过一个逐步示例追踪了各阶段的执行过程。 本小节其余部分将依次描述每个阶段。

paragraphs.en: To implement the ToT-VR process described above, we use GPT-5 through the OpenAI API. A Python script controls the five reasoning stages for each vulnerable function. It first prepares the source code, the selected vulnerable lines, up to 20 critical lines, and the typed line relations between these lines. Each critical line contains only its physical line number and source-code text. The source code and critical lines are used to initialize candidate branches. The selected vulnerable lines and typed line relations are then used to refine the trigger points, dependency paths, and causal descriptions of the retained branches. The official CVE description is provided only during branch verification. After verification, the retained branch is converted into a natural-language vulnerability description. This description serves as the target of the Description task during multi-task fine-tuning. The intermediate branches and structural records are stored for traceability, but they are not included in the final fine-tuning input. The script also handles temporary API errors and checks the output format to maintain consistent results.

paragraphs.en: We construct the training dataset from BigVul [ 18 ] , DiverseVul [ 19 ] , and additional vulnerable functions collected from CVE reports published between 2019 and 2026. Based on these samples, we formulate four tasks, including Detection, Description, Localization, and Assessment. The Detection task predicts whether a function is vulnerable. Given a source function, the model outputs “Yes” or “No” according to its vulnerability label. The Localization task identifies the vulnerable lines in a function. Vulnerable samples use the vulnerable-line annotations described in Section II-B , while nonvulnerable samples use N/A . The Assessment task predicts the vulnerability severity. Vulnerable samples use the severity level derived from the CVSS v3.0 score, while nonvulnerable samples use N/A . The Description task generates a vulnerability explanation. Vulnerable samples use the descriptions generated by ToT-VR in Section II-C , while nonvulnerable samples use a response indicating that no vulnerability exists. Detection is the primary task, while Description, Localization, and Assessment provide additional information about the vulnerability cause, affected lines, and severity. Table II summarizes the target formats of each task, and Table III presents the severity mapping used for Assessment. More details about dataset construction and task distribution are provided in Section III-A .

paragraphs.en: We implement all experiments using PyTorch [ 25 ] , Hugging Face Transformers [ 26 ] , and Unsloth [ 27 ] . paragraphs.en: Comparison with Encoder Baselines. Among the seven encoder baselines, CodeBERTa achieves the highest average F1 score of 59.26%. All four GRAML models outperform this result, with average F1 scores ranging from 66.67% to 68.70%. This corresponds to improvements of 7.41% to 9.44% over CodeBERTa ( 66.67 % − 59.26 % 66.67\%-59.26\% and 68.70 % − 59.26 % 68.70\%-59.26\% ). Among the GRAML models, CodeLlama-7B achieves the highest overall average F1 score of 68.70%. GRAML also outperforms all encoder baselines on every test set. The smallest improvement is 1.33% on the ID test set, where Mistral-7B achieves 72.19% compared with 70.86% for UniXcoder. The largest improvement is 18.22% on Juliet, where CodeLlama-7B achieves 77.78% compared with 59.56% for CodeBERTa. These results show that GRAML consistently outperforms the encoder baselines.

paragraphs.en: To examine whether GRAML captures vulnerability semantics rather than relying on surface-level code patterns, we conduct robustness experiments following the adversarial evaluation framework of Risse et al. [ 32 ] . We evaluate CodeLlama and Mistral as two representative GRAML backbones. CodeLlama is a code-specialized model and achieves the highest average F1 score in the main comparison, while Mistral is a general-purpose model. These two models therefore represent different backbone types and cover distinct performance patterns of GRAML.
paragraphs.zh: 为了检验 GRAML 是否真正捕捉到了漏洞的语义，而非仅仅依赖表层代码模式，我们遵循 Risse 等人 [32] 提出的对抗性评估框架，开展了稳健性实验。 我们将 CodeLlama 和 Mistral 作为两种具有代表性的 GRAML 基础模型进行评估。 CodeLlama 是一款专门针对代码的模型，在主对比实验中获得了最高的平均 F1 分数，而 Mistral 则是一款通用型模型。 因此，这两种模型代表了不同类型的 GRAML 基础模型，并涵盖了 GRAML 不同的性能模式。

paragraphs.en: Using these two representative backbones, we evaluate GRAML under a series of semantics-preserving code transformations. Table VIII summarizes the seven transformations used in the robustness evaluation. These transformations are grouped into three categories. Semantic obfuscation (tf1–tf3) changes identifiers and comments without modifying program behavior. Long-context noise (tf4–tf5) inserts irrelevant content into the input. Structural restructuring (tf6–tf7) changes the organization of the code while preserving its semantics.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用这两种具有代表性的基础模型，在一系列保留语义的代码转换中评估 GRAML。 表 VIII 总结了在鲁棒性评估中使用的七种转换方法。 这些转换方法被分为三类。 语义混淆（tf1–tf3）会更改标识符和注释，但不会改变程序行为。 长上下文噪声（tf4–tf5）会将无关内容插入输入中。 结构重组（tf6–tf7）会改变代码的组织方式，同时保留其语义。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate the contributions of the main components in GRAML, we conduct ablation studies from two perspectives. First, we examine the effectiveness of multi-task supervision by removing different auxiliary tasks from the unified four-task framework. Second, we evaluate the graph-evidence pipeline by changing or removing the CPG-guided supervision used for vulnerability description generation. Both studies are evaluated on the six external datasets.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估 GRAML 中主要组件的贡献，我们从两个角度进行了消融研究。 首先，我们通过从统一的四任务框架中移除不同的辅助任务，来检验多任务监督的有效性。 其次，我们通过更改或移除用于漏洞描述生成的 CPG 引导监督，来评估图证据流程。 这两项研究均在六个外部数据集上进行了评估。

sents.zh: 为了评估 GRAML 中主要组件的贡献，我们从两个角度进行了消融研究。

paragraphs.en: GRAML jointly optimizes the primary vulnerability Detection task together with three auxiliary tasks, namely Description, Localization, and Assessment. To determine whether these auxiliary tasks improve vulnerability detection and to measure the contribution of each task, we compare the full GRAML configuration with four ablated models. The Detection Only variant retains only the primary Detection task and removes all three auxiliary tasks. The abbreviation w/o means “without.” Therefore, w/o Description , w/o Localization , and w/o Assessment remove the corresponding auxiliary task individually while retaining the other tasks. We conduct this ablation study using CodeLlama and Mistral as two representative backbones that exhibit different performance characteristics in the main comparison. Table IX reports the F1 scores of the full configuration and the four ablated models on the six external datasets.
paragraphs.zh: GRAML 联合优化了核心的漏洞检测任务以及三个辅助任务，即描述、定位和评估。 为了确定这些辅助任务是否提升了漏洞检测效果，并衡量每个任务的贡献度，我们将完整的 GRAML 配置与四个消融模型进行了比较。 “仅检测”变体只保留了核心的检测任务，并移除了所有三个辅助任务。 缩写 w/o 表示“没有”。因此，w/o Description、w/o Localization 和 w/o Assessment 分别移除了对应的辅助任务，同时保留了其他任务。 我们使用 CodeLlama 和 Mistral 作为两个具有不同性能特征的典型骨干模型，来进行这项消融研究。 表 IX 报告了完整配置和四个消融模型在六个外部数据集上的 F1 分数。

paragraphs.en: Overall Effect of Multi-Task Supervision. The results show that training only on the Detection task is less effective than using the complete multi-task framework. Compared with Full GRAML, the Detection Only setting decreases the average F1 score by 5.83% for CodeLlama ( 68.39 % − 62.56 % 68.39\%-62.56\% ) and 13.25% for Mistral ( 65.75 % − 52.50 % 65.75\%-52.50\% ). The decline is observed across both backbones, showing that the three auxiliary tasks jointly provide useful supervision for vulnerability detection.
paragraphs.zh: 多任务监督的整体效果。 结果表明，仅针对检测任务进行训练的效果不如使用完整的多任务框架。 与 Full GRAML 相比，仅检测设置使 CodeLlama 的平均 F1 分数下降了 5.83%（68.39% − 62.56%），Mistral 的下降幅度为 13.25%（65.75% − 52.50%）。 两种骨干网络都观察到了这种下降，这表明三个辅助任务共同对漏洞检测提供了有效的监督。

paragraphs.en: w/ Direct CPG replaces the GPT-5-generated natural-language vulnerability descriptions with raw CPG serializations extracted by Joern. The Detection, Localization, and Assessment tasks remain unchanged. This variant examines whether directly using graph structures provides the same supervision as transforming them into natural-language vulnerability descriptions.

paragraphs.en: Effect of Direct CPG Supervision. As shown in Table X , natural-language descriptions provide stronger supervision than raw CPG serializations. For CodeLlama, the average F1 score reaches 68.39% with natural-language descriptions, compared with 66.44% with raw CPG serializations. DeepSeek shows a similar pattern, with 66.70% and 65.84%, respectively. The same advantage appears for Mistral and Qwen. These gains suggest that a natural-language description turns the scattered data-flow and control-flow relations into a coherent, self-contained explanation, which the model can absorb more easily than a raw graph.

paragraphs.en: Effect of Removing Graph Evidence. As shown in Table X , graph evidence contributes substantially to detection performance. For Mistral, the average F1 score reaches 65.75% with graph evidence, but only 52.03% without it. CodeLlama shows a similar trend, with 68.39% and 65.23%, respectively. paragraphs.en: To evaluate the effectiveness of ToT-VR, we compare it with standard CoT for constructing vulnerability descriptions. Both methods use GPT-5, while the remaining data construction and training settings are kept unchanged. We separately construct two training sets using the descriptions generated by CoT and ToT-VR, and then fine-tune CodeLlama, Mistral, DeepSeek, and Qwen on each training set. The resulting models are evaluated on six external datasets. This controlled comparison isolates the effect of the reasoning strategy used for description generation.
paragraphs.zh: 为评估 ToT-VR 的有效性，我们将其与标准的 CoT 方法进行比较，用于构建漏洞描述。 两种方法均使用 GPT-5，而其他数据构建和训练设置保持不变。 我们分别使用 CoT 和 ToT-VR 生成的描述构建两个训练集，然后在每个训练集上对 CodeLlama、Mistral、DeepSeek 和 Qwen 进行微调。 最终得到的模型在六个外部数据集上进行评估。 这种受控比较能够单独分析用于生成描述的推理策略所产生的影响。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table XI , ToT-VR consistently outperforms CoT across all four backbones and all six datasets. Across the four backbones, the overall average F1 score increases from 64.08% with CoT to 67.22% with ToT-VR, corresponding to an improvement of 3.14% ( 67.22 % − 64.08 % 67.22\%-64.08\% ). At the model level, the average improvements range from 2.17% for Mistral to 3.66% for CodeLlama. More importantly, ToT-VR achieves higher F1 scores in all 24 model–dataset comparisons, showing that its benefit is consistent rather than limited to a particular backbone or benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: 如表 XI 所示，ToT-VR 在所有四种基础模型和所有六个数据集上的表现均持续优于 CoT。 在四种基础模型中，整体平均 F1 分数从使用 CoT 时的 64.08% 提升至使用 ToT-VR 时的 67.22%，即提升了 3.14%（67.22% − 64.08%）。 在模型层面，平均提升幅度从 Mistral 的 2.17% 到 CodeLlama 的 3.66% 不等。 更重要的是，ToT-VR 在所有 24 组模型与数据集的比较中均获得了更高的 F1 分数，这表明其优势是一贯存在的，而非仅限于某种特定的基础模型或基准测试。

paragraphs.en: Unlike standard CoT, which follows a single linear reasoning path, ToT-VR explores several candidate interpretations of the same function and keeps only those that survive the reflection and pruning stages. This search process makes ToT-VR less sensitive to early mistakes in the reasoning chain, since a branch that misreads the code can be dropped and replaced by a more plausible alternative. The descriptions produced in this way therefore align more closely with the actual vulnerability, and this alignment is what the downstream fine-tuning ultimately benefits from.
paragraphs.zh: 与遵循单一线性推理路径的标准 CoT 不同，ToT-VR 会探索同一函数的多个候选解释，并仅保留那些通过反思和剪枝阶段的解释。 这种搜索过程使 ToT-VR 对推理链早期的错误不那么敏感，因为一个错误解读代码的分支可以被舍弃，并由更合理的替代方案取代。 因此，以这种方式生成的描述能更准确地与实际的漏洞相对应，而这种准确性正是下游微调最终受益的关键。

paragraphs.en: To complement the PR-curve analysis, we further examine how the F1 score changes with the decision threshold. Mistral achieves an F1 score of 72.19% at its selected threshold, while the other three models obtain similar results. As the threshold increases further, the F1 scores of all four models decrease because fewer samples are classified as vulnerable, which reduces recall. paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 8 , all four backbones achieve their highest average F1 scores at r = 32 r=32 . CodeLlama and Qwen show similar performance trends and reach their best results at this setting. DeepSeek also performs best at r = 32 r=32 , while Mistral exhibits greater variation across different rank values but still achieves its highest score at r = 32 r=32 . These results indicate that r = 32 r=32 provides the most effective and consistent configuration across the four backbones. We therefore use r = 32 r=32 in the main experiments. paragraphs.en: Although LLMs such as CodeLlama [ 22 ] and DeepSeek-Coder [ 24 ] have demonstrated strong performance in vulnerability detection [ 1 , 46 ] , recent benchmarks suggest that such performance may be overestimated due to dataset noise and evaluation artifacts [ 8 ] . Furthermore, LLMs may still rely on superficial cues, such as variable names, rather than genuine semantic reasoning. As shown by [ 32 ] , this reliance can cause performance drops under code obfuscation, highlighting the need for frameworks like GRAML that guide LLMs to capture the underlying causal logic of vulnerabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 CodeLlama [ 22 ] 和 DeepSeek-Coder [ 24 ] 等大型语言模型在漏洞检测方面表现出强劲的性能 [ 1 , 46 ]，但近期的基准测试表明，由于数据集噪声和评估伪影的影响，这种性能可能被高估了 [ 8]。 此外，大型语言模型可能仍然依赖变量名等表面线索，而非真正的语义推理。 正如 [ 32 ] 所示，这种依赖关系可能导致代码混淆时性能下降，凸显了 GRAML 这类框架的必要性——这些框架能够引导大型语言模型捕捉漏洞的底层因果逻辑。

paragraphs.en: To address the limitations of treating code purely as text, researchers have gradually incorporated structural information into LLM-based vulnerability analysis. Early approaches combined static structure with dynamic symbolic traces to enrich contextual information beyond linear tokens [ 47 ] , while subsequent research leveraged CPGs to expose control and data flow dependencies difficult to capture from linear code sequences [ 11 , 48 ] . For example, LLMxCPG [ 11 ] uses CPG-derived context to assist LLM-based vulnerability analysis. In contrast, GRAML uses CPG evidence as a training-time constraint and distills it into natural-language supervision, so that the fine-tuned detector does not require graph evidence at inference. More recent methods have explored instruction-level graphs and LLM-enhanced code representations to improve generalization in vulnerability prediction [ 49 ] . Benchmarks indicate that models still struggle to interpret long-range data flow contexts [ 6 ] , and graph-based methods can be sensitive to noisy structural dependencies and long-range relations [ 50 ] . Static-analysis-assisted LLM frameworks also use program analysis results to augment reasoning about vulnerabilities [ 7 ] . In addition, hybrid fusion of language models and graph neural networks has been explored to jointly model structural and semantic features for vulnerability classification [ 12 ] , and lightweight directed graph constructions capture multi-scale lexical co-occurrence and fine-grained structural dependencies [ 51 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决将代码纯粹视为文本所带来的局限性，研究人员逐渐开始将结构信息整合到基于大型语言模型（LLM）的漏洞分析中。 早期的方法将静态结构与动态符号追踪相结合，以丰富超越线性词元的上下文信息 [ 47 ]；而后续研究则利用控制流图（CPG）来揭示那些难以从线性代码序列中捕捉的控制流和数据流依赖关系 [ 11 , 48 ]。 例如，LLMxCPG [ 11 ] 利用源自 CPG 的上下文信息来辅助基于 LLM 的漏洞分析。 相比之下，GRAML 将 CPG 证据作为训练时的约束条件，并将其提炼为自然语言形式的监督信号，使得微调后的检测器在推理阶段无需依赖图结构证据。 更近期的方法则探索了指令级图结构和经 LLM 增强的代码表示，以提升漏洞预测的泛化能力 [ 49 ]。 基准测试表明，模型在解读长距离数据流上下文方面仍存在困难 [ 6]；而基于图的方法可能对噪声较多的结构依赖和长距离关系较为敏感 [ 50]。 静态分析辅助的 LLM 框架也会利用程序分析结果来增强对漏洞的推理能力 [ 7]。 此外，研究还探索了语言模型与图神经网络相结合的混合融合方法，以联合建模结构特征和语义特征用于漏洞分类 [ 12]；同时，轻量级的有向图构建方法能够捕捉多尺度的词汇共现关系和精细的结构依赖 [ 51]。

paragraphs.en: Recent work has further advanced structure-aware vulnerability detection by integrating fine-grained program graph analysis. For example, GraphFVD [ 13 ] extracts detailed structural features from program graphs and leverages hierarchical embeddings to capture syntax and semantic information relevant to vulnerabilities. Similarly, Zou et al. [ 14 ] propose a vulnerability detection framework based on an augmented program dependency graph and optimized CodeBERT, extending traditional PDG structures to better preserve semantic and structural code information. Motivated by these observations, our approach leverages structural dependencies to guide vulnerability analysis, allowing GPT-5 to explore execution-aware interpretations grounded in the code’s control and data flow.

paragraphs.en: Beyond structural integration, explicit reasoning and multi-task supervision are important for improving the reliability of LLM-based vulnerability analysis. CoT prompting [ 52 ] improves reasoning by eliciting intermediate reasoning paths, while Self-Consistency [ 53 ] aggregates multiple reasoning results to enhance stability. Tree of Thoughts (ToT) further extends this process into a structured search over multiple candidate reasoning branches [ 20 , 54 ] . In the context of security research, explicit reasoning frameworks have been shown to provide detailed insights into vulnerability causes and improve interpretability in automated analysis [ 55 ] . Recent studies have also adopted semantic analysis for vulnerability repair and root cause analysis [ 56 ] . Evaluations across multiple tasks suggest that jointly considering multiple objectives yields more robust performance than optimizing single tasks independently [ 57 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 除了结构整合之外，显式推理和多任务监督对于提升基于大型语言模型（LLM）的漏洞分析可靠性也至关重要。 CoT提示方法[ 52 ]通过引出中间推理路径来增强推理能力，而自我一致性方法[ 53 ]则通过聚合多个推理结果来提高稳定性。 思维树（ToT）方法进一步将这一过程扩展为对多个候选推理分支的结构化搜索[ 20 , 54 ]。 在安全研究领域，已有研究表明，显式推理框架能够深入揭示漏洞成因，并提升自动化分析的可解释性[ 55 ]。 近期研究还引入了语义分析方法，用于漏洞修复和根本原因分析[ 56 ]。 多项任务的评估结果表明，联合考虑多个目标比单独优化单个任务能带来更稳健的性能表现[ 57 ]。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, fine-tuning methods that are parameter efficient, such as LoRA [ 58 ] and QLoRA [ 59 ] , enable efficient adaptation of large foundation models to downstream tasks without retraining the full network. paragraphs.en: Code structure is important for helping LLMs go beyond surface-level patterns. GRAML focuses on vulnerability detection, which determines whether a given function is vulnerable. Before constructing the multi-task training dataset, GRAML uses CPG-based structural evidence to guide GPT-5 in generating vulnerability descriptions. These descriptions serve as the target outputs of the Description task and help encode the causal logic behind vulnerabilities. GRAML then builds a unified four-task dataset around the main Detection task. The Description task explains why the vulnerability occurs, the Localization task identifies where the vulnerable lines are, and the Assessment task estimates how severe the vulnerability is. Together, these tasks help the model learn not only whether a function is vulnerable, but also why it is vulnerable, where the problem occurs, and how serious the impact is. By learning from these structurally guided descriptions and auxiliary labels, GRAML reduces the model’s reliance on shallow cues such as variable names, improves detection performance on ID data, and generalizes better to OOD benchmarks.

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we present GRAML, a vulnerability detection framework that combines reliability-aware CPG evidence extraction, ToT-VR-based vulnerability description generation, and multi-task instruction tuning. GRAML selects critical source lines and typed control-flow and data-flow relations, which guide GPT-5 in generating natural-language descriptions of the vulnerability cause, the affected code regions, and the potential security consequences. These descriptions are jointly learned with Detection, Localization, and Assessment tasks, while the fine-tuned models require only source code during inference. Experimental results on the ID test set and six external datasets show that the best GRAML model achieves an average F1 score of 68.70%, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines by up to 30.92%. The ablation results further demonstrate that converting graph evidence into natural-language supervision is more effective than directly using raw CPG serializations or removing graph evidence. GRAML also maintains consistent performance under the evaluated semantics-preserving code transformations. Overall, the results demonstrate the effectiveness of integrating static program analysis, structured reasoning, and multi-task supervision for LLM-based vulnerability detection.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 GRAML——一个漏洞检测框架，该框架结合了可靠性感知的 CPG 证据提取、基于 ToT-VR 的漏洞描述生成以及多任务指令微调。 GRAML 会选择关键的源代码行以及带类型的控制流和数据流关系，这些关系会引导 GPT-5 生成关于漏洞原因、受影响的代码区域及潜在安全后果的自然语言描述。 这些描述与检测、定位和评估任务共同学习，而经过微调的模型在推理阶段仅需源代码。 在 ID 测试集和六个外部数据集上的实验结果表明，最佳 GRAML 模型的平均 F1 分数为 68.70%，比当前最先进的基线模型高出最多 30.92%。 消融实验结果进一步表明，将图证据转换为自然语言监督比直接使用原始的 CPG 序列化或移除图证据更为有效。 GRAML 在评估的语义保留代码转换下也能保持稳定的性能。 总体而言，这些结果表明，将静态程序分析、结构化推理和多任务监督整合到基于 LLM 的漏洞检测中是有效的。

paragraphs.en: When generating vulnerability descriptions, using the entire function as input may introduce irrelevant information and obscure vulnerability-related code. In contrast, using only the vulnerable lines may remove the semantic context required to understand the vulnerability. To address these issues, we use Joern to construct CPGs and extract structural information from the source code. The resulting graph information is subsequently processed to support vulnerability description generation with GPT-5.
paragraphs.zh: 在生成漏洞描述时，若将整个函数作为输入，可能会引入无关信息，并掩盖与漏洞相关的代码。 相比之下，仅使用存在漏洞的代码行，则可能移除理解该漏洞所需的语义上下文。 为解决这些问题，我们使用 Joern 构建 CPG，并从源代码中提取结构信息。 随后对生成的图信息进行进一步处理，以支持利用 GPT-5 生成漏洞描述。

sents.en: When generating vulnerability descriptions, using the entire function as input may introduce irrelevant information and obscure vulnerability-related code.

sents.zh: 相比之下，仅使用存在漏洞的代码行，则可能移除理解该漏洞所需的语义上下文。

sents.en: To address these issues, we use Joern to construct CPGs and extract structural information from the source code.
sents.zh: 为解决这些问题，我们使用 Joern 构建 CPG，并从源代码中提取结构信息。

sents.en: The resulting graph information is subsequently processed to support vulnerability description generation with GPT-5.
sents.zh: 随后对生成的图信息进行进一步处理，以支持利用 GPT-5 生成漏洞描述。

paragraphs.en: Applying Joern to vulnerability datasets is challenging because many samples are incomplete code snippets rather than complete compilable projects. To improve parsing stability and obtain usable CPGs, we address the following issues:
paragraphs.zh: 将 Joern 应用于漏洞数据集具有挑战性，因为许多样本都是不完整的代码片段，而非可完整编译的项目。 为了提高解析稳定性并获得可用的 CPG，我们解决了以下问题：

sents.en: Applying Joern to vulnerability datasets is challenging because many samples are incomplete code snippets rather than complete compilable projects.
sents.zh: 将 Joern 应用于漏洞数据集具有挑战性，因为许多样本都是不完整的代码片段，而非可完整编译的项目。

sents.en: To improve parsing stability and obtain usable CPGs, we address the following issues:
sents.zh: 为了提高解析稳定性并获得可用的 CPG，我们解决了以下问题：

paragraphs.en: Problem: Many vulnerability datasets contain only isolated functions. Joern may fail to parse C++ scope resolution operators such as :: when the surrounding class or namespace definitions are unavailable.
paragraphs.zh: 问题：许多漏洞数据集仅包含孤立的函数。 当周围的类或命名空间定义不可用时，Joern 可能无法解析 C++ 中的作用域解析运算符（如 ::）。

sents.en: Problem: Many vulnerability datasets contain only isolated functions.
sents.zh: 问题：许多漏洞数据集仅包含孤立的函数。

sents.en: Joern may fail to parse C++ scope resolution operators such as :: when the surrounding class or namespace definitions are unavailable.
sents.zh: 当周围的类或命名空间定义不可用时，Joern 可能无法解析 C++ 中的作用域解析运算符（如 ::）。

paragraphs.en: Solution: We normalize the source code before parsing by replacing :: with __ . This preprocessing step reduces parsing failures and allows Joern to construct the corresponding abstract syntax tree and CPG.
paragraphs.zh: 解决方案：在解析之前，我们通过将 :: 替换为 __ 来对源代码进行标准化处理。 这一预处理步骤可以减少解析失败的情况，并使 Joern 能够构建相应的抽象语法树和 CPG。

sents.en: Solution: We normalize the source code before parsing by replacing :: with __ .
sents.zh: 解决方案：在解析之前，我们通过将 :: 替换为 __ 来对源代码进行标准化处理。

sents.en: This preprocessing step reduces parsing failures and allows Joern to construct the corresponding abstract syntax tree and CPG.
sents.zh: 这一预处理步骤可以减少解析失败的情况，并使 Joern 能够构建相应的抽象语法树和 CPG。

paragraphs.en: Challenge 2: Dense and Redundant Graphs.
paragraphs.zh: 挑战 2：密集且冗余的图。

paragraphs.en: Problem: The raw DOT graphs generated with the --repr all option contain numerous nodes and edges. Some nodes represent metadata, such as METHOD declarations, while some edges connect nodes located on the same source line. These elements increase graph size without providing useful line-level context.
paragraphs.zh: 问题：使用 --repr all 选项生成的原始 DOT 图包含大量节点和边。 某些节点表示元数据，例如 METHOD 声明，而某些边则连接位于同一源行上的节点。 这些元素会增加图的大小，但并未提供有用的行级上下文信息。

sents.en: Problem: The raw DOT graphs generated with the --repr all option contain numerous nodes and edges.
sents.zh: 问题：使用 --repr all 选项生成的原始 DOT 图包含大量节点和边。

sents.en: Some nodes represent metadata, such as METHOD declarations, while some edges connect nodes located on the same source line.
sents.zh: 某些节点表示元数据，例如 METHOD 声明，而某些边则连接位于同一源行上的节点。

sents.en: These elements increase graph size without providing useful line-level context.
sents.zh: 这些元素会增加图的大小，但并未提供有用的行级上下文信息。

paragraphs.en: Solution: We retain only nodes associated with valid source-line numbers and remove metadata nodes. We also discard edges whose source and target nodes belong to the same line. The remaining graph contains four relation types: Control Flow ( CFG ), Control Dependence ( CDG ), Data Dependence ( REACHING_DEF ), and Function Call ( CALL ). These relations are then mapped to line-level structural representations.
paragraphs.zh: 解决方案：我们仅保留与有效源行号相关的节点，并删除元数据节点。 我们还丢弃那些源节点和目标节点属于同一行的边。 剩余的图包含四种关系类型：控制流（CFG）、控制依赖（CDG）、数据依赖（REACHING_DEF）和函数调用（CALL）。 随后，这些关系被映射到行级别的结构性表示中。

sents.en: Solution: We retain only nodes associated with valid source-line numbers and remove metadata nodes.
sents.zh: 解决方案：我们仅保留与有效源行号相关的节点，并删除元数据节点。

sents.en: We also discard edges whose source and target nodes belong to the same line.
sents.zh: 我们还丢弃那些源节点和目标节点属于同一行的边。

sents.en: The remaining graph contains four relation types: Control Flow ( CFG ), Control Dependence ( CDG ), Data Dependence ( REACHING_DEF ), and Function Call ( CALL ).
sents.zh: 剩余的图包含四种关系类型：控制流（CFG）、控制依赖（CDG）、数据依赖（REACHING_DEF）和函数调用（CALL）。

sents.en: These relations are then mapped to line-level structural representations.
sents.zh: 随后，这些关系被映射到行级别的结构性表示中。

paragraphs.en: Challenge 3: Residual Files during Batch Processing.
paragraphs.zh: 挑战 3：批量处理过程中的残留文件。

paragraphs.en: Problem: Joern may raise internal errors when processing malformed or complex code snippets. Such failures can leave residual files, including replay_pid*.log , which consume storage space and interfere with large-scale batch processing.
paragraphs.zh: 问题：Joern 在处理格式错误或复杂的代码片段时，可能会引发内部错误。 此类故障可能会留下残留文件，包括 replay_pid*.log，这些文件会占用存储空间并干扰大规模批量处理。

sents.en: Problem: Joern may raise internal errors when processing malformed or complex code snippets.
sents.zh: 问题：Joern 在处理格式错误或复杂的代码片段时，可能会引发内部错误。

sents.en: Such failures can leave residual files, including replay_pid*.log , which consume storage space and interfere with large-scale batch processing.
sents.zh: 此类故障可能会留下残留文件，包括 replay_pid*.log，这些文件会占用存储空间并干扰大规模批量处理。

paragraphs.en: Solution: We execute Joern through a multiprocessing wrapper that isolates each parsing process, suppresses unnecessary input and output streams, and removes residual files after execution. This design allows the pipeline to continue processing subsequent samples when individual parsing failures occur.
paragraphs.zh: 解决方案：我们通过一个多进程包装器来执行 Joern，该包装器可以隔离每个解析过程、抑制不必要的输入和输出流，并在执行后删除残留文件。 这种设计使得在单个解析失败时，流程仍能继续处理后续样本。

sents.en: Solution: We execute Joern through a multiprocessing wrapper that isolates each parsing process, suppresses unnecessary input and output streams, and removes residual files after execution.
sents.zh: 解决方案：我们通过一个多进程包装器来执行 Joern，该包装器可以隔离每个解析过程、抑制不必要的输入和输出流，并在执行后删除残留文件。

sents.en: This design allows the pipeline to continue processing subsequent samples when individual parsing failures occur.
sents.zh: 这种设计使得在单个解析失败时，流程仍能继续处理后续样本。

paragraphs.en: As described in the main manuscript, ToT-VR generates vulnerability descriptions through five sequential stages. We implement this process using the GPT-5 API and generate multiple candidate descriptions for each vulnerable sample before selecting the final result.
paragraphs.zh: 如主手稿所述，ToT-VR 通过五个连续阶段生成漏洞描述。 我们使用 GPT-5 API 实现这一流程，并为每个漏洞样本生成多个候选描述，然后再选择最终结果。

sents.en: As described in the main manuscript, ToT-VR generates vulnerability descriptions through five sequential stages.
sents.zh: 如主手稿所述，ToT-VR 通过五个连续阶段生成漏洞描述。

sents.en: We implement this process using the GPT-5 API and generate multiple candidate descriptions for each vulnerable sample before selecting the final result.
sents.zh: 我们使用 GPT-5 API 实现这一流程，并为每个漏洞样本生成多个候选描述，然后再选择最终结果。

paragraphs.en: ToT-VR introduces additional processing time because each sample requires five sequential API calls. Generating descriptions for 410 vulnerable samples in one iteration takes approximately three hours. Unlike few-shot generation, which requires only one API call for each sample, ToT-VR performs five consecutive reasoning stages. Because the prompt at Step N N depends on the output of Step N − 1 N-1 , the five calls for the same sample cannot be executed in parallel.
paragraphs.zh: ToT-VR 会引入额外的处理时间，因为每个样本都需要依次执行五次 API 调用。 在一次迭代中生成 410 个脆弱样本的描述大约需要三小时。 与少样本生成不同，后者每个样本只需一次 API 调用，而 ToT-VR 则需要执行五个连续的阶段推理。 由于第 N 步的提示依赖于第 N−1 步的输出，因此对同一样本的五次调用无法并行执行。

sents.en: ToT-VR introduces additional processing time because each sample requires five sequential API calls.
sents.zh: ToT-VR 会引入额外的处理时间，因为每个样本都需要依次执行五次 API 调用。

sents.en: Generating descriptions for 410 vulnerable samples in one iteration takes approximately three hours.
sents.zh: 在一次迭代中生成 410 个脆弱样本的描述大约需要三小时。

sents.en: Unlike few-shot generation, which requires only one API call for each sample, ToT-VR performs five consecutive reasoning stages.
sents.zh: 与少样本生成不同，后者每个样本只需一次 API 调用，而 ToT-VR 则需要执行五个连续的阶段推理。

sents.en: Because the prompt at Step N N depends on the output of Step N − 1 N-1 , the five calls for the same sample cannot be executed in parallel.
sents.zh: 由于第 N 步的提示依赖于第 N−1 步的输出，因此对同一样本的五次调用无法并行执行。

paragraphs.en: The generated descriptions may vary across runs because of the nondeterministic nature of LLM generation. We therefore use multiple iterations rather than relying on a single generation result. Specifically, we run the complete ToT-VR pipeline five times for each of the 410 samples, producing five candidate vulnerability descriptions for every sample.
paragraphs.zh: 由于 LLM 生成过程具有非确定性，生成的描述在不同运行中可能会有所不同。 因此，我们采用多次迭代，而不是依赖单次生成结果。 具体来说，我们对每个 410 个样本运行完整的 ToT-VR 流程五次，从而为每个样本生成五个候选漏洞描述。

sents.en: The generated descriptions may vary across runs because of the nondeterministic nature of LLM generation.
sents.zh: 由于 LLM 生成过程具有非确定性，生成的描述在不同运行中可能会有所不同。

sents.en: We therefore use multiple iterations rather than relying on a single generation result.
sents.zh: 因此，我们采用多次迭代，而不是依赖单次生成结果。

sents.en: Specifically, we run the complete ToT-VR pipeline five times for each of the 410 samples, producing five candidate vulnerability descriptions for every sample.
sents.zh: 具体来说，我们对每个 410 个样本运行完整的 ToT-VR 流程五次，从而为每个样本生成五个候选漏洞描述。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the candidate descriptions according to the following four criteria:
paragraphs.zh: 我们根据以下四个标准来评估候选描述：

paragraphs.en: Root Cause Accuracy. The description should correctly identify the primary cause of the vulnerability and remain consistent with the corresponding CWE or CVE information.

paragraphs.en: The four tasks in the multi-task fine-tuning framework are represented using a unified instruction format. Each training instance is composed of a task-specific instruction, a source-code input, and a target response. The task instruction describes what the model is expected to do and the exact format of the expected output. All four tasks share the same global system prompt: “You are a security assistant for vulnerability detection, assessment, location and description.” During fine-tuning, the instruction and source-code tokens are masked from the loss computation, and the loss is calculated only on the target-response tokens.

Therefore, we use the official conversational template for each target model. Table XIII summarizes the formatting structures used in our Unsloth based training script.

paragraphs.en: We also implement a custom completion-only data collator. For each model, the collator identifies the token sequence that marks the beginning of the assistant response according to the corresponding template in Table XIII . It then sets the labels of all preceding tokens to -100 . Consequently, the training loss is computed only on the assistant response, which contains the vulnerability detection result and explanation, rather than on the system prompt, user instruction, or input code.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还实现了一个自定义的仅补全数据整理器。 对于每个模型，该整理器会根据表 XIII 中对应的模板，识别出标志着助手响应开始的令牌序列。 然后，它将所有前导令牌的标签设为 -100。 因此，训练损失仅基于助手响应进行计算，而该响应包含漏洞检测结果和解释，而非系统提示、用户指令或输入代码。

paragraphs.en: The maximum sequence length used in fine-tuning is determined by both the length of training samples and the available GPU memory. paragraphs.zh: 微调中使用的最大序列长度由训练样本的长度和可用的 GPU 内存共同决定。 如上所述，我们将 Mistral 的最大序列长度设为 8,192，而 DeepSeek、CodeLlama 和 Qwen 的最大序列长度设为 16,384。 本小节将解释这一设置背后的原因。

paragraphs.en: Each training input contains the task instruction, source code, extracted graph aware context, and target response. Therefore, short sequence lengths may truncate not only the source code but also the structural context or the expected output. To examine this issue, we analyze the token length distribution of the training dataset. Since source code is often fragmented and may produce more tokens than natural language, we estimate token length conservatively. As shown in Table XIV , 91.04% of the training samples are within 2,048 tokens. However, 2.97% of the samples exceed 4,096 tokens, and 0.93% exceed 8,192 tokens. Some samples are even longer than 16,384 tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 每个训练输入都包含任务说明、源代码、提取出的图感知上下文以及目标响应。 因此，较短的序列长度不仅可能截断源代码，还可能截断结构上下文或预期输出。 为了研究这个问题，我们分析了训练数据集中标记长度的分布情况。 由于源代码通常是片段化的，并且可能产生比自然语言更多的标记，我们对标记长度进行了保守估计。 如表 XIV 所示，91.04% 的训练样本在 2,048 个标记以内。 然而，2.97% 的样本超过了 4,096 个标记，而 0.93% 的样本超过了 8,192 个标记。 一些样本的长度甚至超过了 16,384 个标记。

paragraphs.en: Based on this distribution, commonly used sequence lengths such as 2,048 or 4,096 would cut off many training samples. We set the maximum sequence length to 8,192 for Mistral and 16,384 for DeepSeek, CodeLlama, and Qwen. A small number of samples longer than 16,384 tokens are still cut off. This setting reduces information loss while keeping training feasible on our hardware.

paragraphs.en: As introduced in the robustness evaluation section of the main manuscript, we use semantics-preserving code transformations to examine whether the fine-tuned GRAML models capture vulnerability semantics rather than relying on surface-level code patterns. Following the adversarial evaluation framework of Risse et al. [ 32 ] , we apply seven transformations grouped into three categories: Semantic Obfuscation, Long-Context Noise, and Structural Restructuring. The implementation of each transformation is described below.
paragraphs.zh: 如主稿的鲁棒性评估部分所述，我们使用保留语义的代码转换来检验微调后的 GRAML 模型是否真正捕捉到了漏洞的语义，而非仅仅依赖表层代码模式。 遵循 Risse 等人提出的对抗性评估框架。 [ 32 ] ，我们应用了七种转换，这些转换被归为三类：语义混淆、长上下文噪声和结构重构。 每种转换的具体实现如下所述。

sents.en: As introduced in the robustness evaluation section of the main manuscript, we use semantics-preserving code transformations to examine whether the fine-tuned GRAML models capture vulnerability semantics rather than relying on surface-level code patterns.
sents.zh: 如主稿的鲁棒性评估部分所述，我们使用保留语义的代码转换来检验微调后的 GRAML 模型是否真正捕捉到了漏洞的语义，而非仅仅依赖表层代码模式。

sents.en: Following the adversarial evaluation framework of Risse et al.
sents.zh: 遵循 Risse 等人提出的对抗性评估框架。

sents.en: [ 32 ] , we apply seven transformations grouped into three categories: Semantic Obfuscation, Long-Context Noise, and Structural Restructuring.
sents.zh: [ 32 ] ，我们应用了七种转换，这些转换被归为三类：语义混淆、长上下文噪声和结构重构。

sents.en: The implementation of each transformation is described below.
sents.zh: 每种转换的具体实现如下所述。

paragraphs.en: This category examines whether the models rely on readable parameter names, function names, or comments. Such lexical information may be unavailable or intentionally modified in real-world vulnerable code. Semantic Obfuscation contains the following three transformations.
paragraphs.zh: 这一类别旨在检验模型是否依赖可读的参数名、函数名或注释。 在实际世界中，这类词汇信息可能不存在，也可能被有意修改。 语义混淆包含以下三种转换方式。

sents.en: This category examines whether the models rely on readable parameter names, function names, or comments.
sents.zh: 这一类别旨在检验模型是否依赖可读的参数名、函数名或注释。

sents.en: Such lexical information may be unavailable or intentionally modified in real-world vulnerable code.
sents.zh: 在实际世界中，这类词汇信息可能不存在，也可能被有意修改。

sents.en: Semantic Obfuscation contains the following three transformations.
sents.zh: 语义混淆包含以下三种转换方式。

paragraphs.en: Parameter Renaming (tf1): We parse each function signature and extract its parameter names, such as buf from void func(char* buf) . We then replace each parameter name in the function body with a randomly generated two-letter string, such as xk . Identifier-boundary checks are applied to avoid replacing substrings within other identifiers.
paragraphs.zh: 参数重命名（tf1）：我们解析每个函数签名，并提取其参数名，例如从 void func(char* buf) 中提取 buf。 接着，我们将函数体中的每个参数名替换为随机生成的两个字母组成的字符串，例如 xk。 我们会执行标识符边界检查，以避免替换其他标识符内部的子字符串。

sents.en: Parameter Renaming (tf1): We parse each function signature and extract its parameter names, such as buf from void func(char* buf) .
sents.zh: 参数重命名（tf1）：我们解析每个函数签名，并提取其参数名，例如从 void func(char* buf) 中提取 buf。

sents.en: We then replace each parameter name in the function body with a randomly generated two-letter string, such as xk .
sents.zh: 接着，我们将函数体中的每个参数名替换为随机生成的两个字母组成的字符串，例如 xk。

sents.en: Identifier-boundary checks are applied to avoid replacing substrings within other identifiers.
sents.zh: 我们会执行标识符边界检查，以避免替换其他标识符内部的子字符串。

paragraphs.en: Function-Name Renaming (tf2): We identify the target function name and replace it with a randomly generated two-letter string. This transformation removes the semantic information conveyed by descriptive function names. For example, test_buffer_overflow may be replaced with qz , requiring the model to analyze the function body rather than its name.
paragraphs.zh: 函数名重命名（tf2）：我们识别目标函数名，并将其替换为一个随机生成的两个字母组成的字符串。 这种转换会消除描述性函数名所传达的语义信息。 例如，test_buffer_overflow 可能会被替换为 qz，这要求模型分析函数体，而不是其名称。

sents.en: Function-Name Renaming (tf2): We identify the target function name and replace it with a randomly generated two-letter string.
sents.zh: 函数名重命名（tf2）：我们识别目标函数名，并将其替换为一个随机生成的两个字母组成的字符串。

sents.en: This transformation removes the semantic information conveyed by descriptive function names.
sents.zh: 这种转换会消除描述性函数名所传达的语义信息。

sents.en: For example, test_buffer_overflow may be replaced with qz , requiring the model to analyze the function body rather than its name.
sents.zh: 例如，test_buffer_overflow 可能会被替换为 qz，这要求模型分析函数体，而不是其名称。

paragraphs.en: Comment Removal (tf3): We use a regular-expression-based parser to remove both single-line comments marked by // and multi-line comments enclosed by /* ... */ . This transformation removes natural-language hints and requires the model to rely on executable code.
paragraphs.zh: 注释移除（tf3）：我们使用基于正则表达式的解析器，移除以 // 标记的单行注释以及由 /* ... */ 包围的多行注释。 这种转换会移除自然语言提示，并要求模型依赖可执行代码。

sents.en: Comment Removal (tf3): We use a regular-expression-based parser to remove both single-line comments marked by // and multi-line comments enclosed by /* ... */ .
sents.zh: 注释移除（tf3）：我们使用基于正则表达式的解析器，移除以 // 标记的单行注释以及由 /* ... */ 包围的多行注释。

sents.en: This transformation removes natural-language hints and requires the model to rely on executable code.
sents.zh: 这种转换会移除自然语言提示，并要求模型依赖可执行代码。

paragraphs.en: This category inserts irrelevant content that increases the input length without changing the behavior of the original program. It examines whether the models can retain vulnerability-related information when the input contains unrelated code or text. Long-Context Noise contains the following two transformations.
paragraphs.zh: 此类操作会插入无关内容，从而增加输入长度，但不会改变原始程序的行为。 它检验模型在输入包含无关代码或文本时，是否能够保留与漏洞相关的信息。 长上下文噪声包含以下两种变换。

sents.en: This category inserts irrelevant content that increases the input length without changing the behavior of the original program.
sents.zh: 此类操作会插入无关内容，从而增加输入长度，但不会改变原始程序的行为。

sents.en: It examines whether the models can retain vulnerability-related information when the input contains unrelated code or text.
sents.zh: 它检验模型在输入包含无关代码或文本时，是否能够保留与漏洞相关的信息。

sents.en: Long-Context Noise contains the following two transformations.
sents.zh: 长上下文噪声包含以下两种变换。

paragraphs.en: Dead-Code Insertion (tf4): We append an unexecuted helper function, void helpfunc() , to each code sample. The function contains a while(false) block with 300 consecutive break statements. Because the condition is always false and the helper function is not called, the inserted code does not affect the behavior of the original function but substantially increases the input length.
paragraphs.zh: 死代码插入 (tf4)：我们在每个代码样本末尾附加一个未执行的辅助函数 void helpfunc()。 该函数包含一个 while(false) 块，其中连续有 300 个 break 语句。 由于条件始终为假且辅助函数未被调用，因此插入的代码不会影响原始函数的行为，但会显著增加输入长度。

sents.en: Dead-Code Insertion (tf4): We append an unexecuted helper function, void helpfunc() , to each code sample.
sents.zh: 死代码插入 (tf4)：我们在每个代码样本末尾附加一个未执行的辅助函数 void helpfunc()。

sents.en: The function contains a while(false) block with 300 consecutive break statements.
sents.zh: 该函数包含一个 while(false) 块，其中连续有 300 个 break 语句。

sents.en: Because the condition is always false and the helper function is not called, the inserted code does not affect the behavior of the original function but substantially increases the input length.
sents.zh: 由于条件始终为假且辅助函数未被调用，因此插入的代码不会影响原始函数的行为，但会显著增加输入长度。

paragraphs.en: Irrelevant-Comment Insertion (tf5): We append a multi-line comment block enclosed by /* ... */ to each code sample. The comment repeats the word break 50 times. The inserted text does not affect program behavior but introduces repetitive lexical noise into the input.
paragraphs.zh: 无关评论插入（tf5）：我们在每个代码示例后追加一个由 /* ... */ 包围的多行评论块。 该评论重复了 break 一词 50 次。 插入的文本不会影响程序行为，但会在输入中引入重复的词汇噪声。

sents.en: Irrelevant-Comment Insertion (tf5): We append a multi-line comment block enclosed by /* ... */ to each code sample.
sents.zh: 无关评论插入（tf5）：我们在每个代码示例后追加一个由 /* ... */ 包围的多行评论块。

sents.en: The comment repeats the word break 50 times.
sents.zh: 该评论重复了 break 一词 50 次。

sents.en: The inserted text does not affect program behavior but introduces repetitive lexical noise into the input.
sents.zh: 插入的文本不会影响程序行为，但会在输入中引入重复的词汇噪声。

paragraphs.en: This category modifies the organization of the source code while preserving its original behavior. It examines whether the models remain effective when vulnerability-related statements are reorganized or preceded by additional function calls. Structural Restructuring contains the following two transformations.
paragraphs.zh: 此类修改会改变源代码的组织结构，同时保留其原始行为。 它检验当与漏洞相关的语句被重新组织或在其前添加额外的函数调用时，模型是否仍然有效。 结构重构包含以下两种转换。

sents.en: This category modifies the organization of the source code while preserving its original behavior.
sents.zh: 此类修改会改变源代码的组织结构，同时保留其原始行为。

sents.en: It examines whether the models remain effective when vulnerability-related statements are reorganized or preceded by additional function calls.
sents.zh: 它检验当与漏洞相关的语句被重新组织或在其前添加额外的函数调用时，模型是否仍然有效。

sents.en: Structural Restructuring contains the following two transformations.
sents.zh: 结构重构包含以下两种转换。

paragraphs.en: Function Extraction (tf6): We locate the boundaries of the original function body through brace matching using { ... } . The body is moved into a new helper function named helper_func , while the original parameters are preserved. The original function is then modified to invoke helper_func with the corresponding arguments. This transformation changes the location and organization of the vulnerability-related logic without modifying its behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 函数提取（tf6）：我们通过匹配花括号 { ... } 来确定原始函数体的边界。 函数体被移动到一个名为 helper_func 的新辅助函数中，同时保留原始参数。 随后，原始函数被修改为使用相应的参数调用 helper_func。 这种转换改变了与漏洞相关的逻辑的位置和结构，但未改变其行为。

sents.en: Function Extraction (tf6): We locate the boundaries of the original function body through brace matching using { ... } .
sents.zh: 函数提取（tf6）：我们通过匹配花括号 { ... } 来确定原始函数体的边界。

sents.en: The body is moved into a new helper function named helper_func , while the original parameters are preserved.
sents.zh: 函数体被移动到一个名为 helper_func 的新辅助函数中，同时保留原始参数。

sents.en: The original function is then modified to invoke helper_func with the corresponding arguments.
sents.zh: 随后，原始函数被修改为使用相应的参数调用 helper_func。

sents.en: This transformation changes the location and organization of the vulnerability-related logic without modifying its behavior.
sents.zh: 这种转换改变了与漏洞相关的逻辑的位置和结构，但未改变其行为。

paragraphs.en: Void-Function Call Insertion (tf7): We define an empty function named void help_func() containing 150 return statements and append it to the code sample. A call to help_func() is inserted immediately after the opening brace of the target function. This transformation introduces an additional benign interprocedural call before the original function logic.
paragraphs.zh: 空函数调用插入（tf7）：我们定义一个名为 void help_func() 的空函数，其中包含 150 条 return 语句，并将其附加到代码示例中。 在目标函数的开括符后立即插入对 help_func() 的调用。 这种转换会在原始函数逻辑之前引入一个额外的良性过程间调用。

sents.en: Void-Function Call Insertion (tf7): We define an empty function named void help_func() containing 150 return statements and append it to the code sample.
sents.zh: 空函数调用插入（tf7）：我们定义一个名为 void help_func() 的空函数，其中包含 150 条 return 语句，并将其附加到代码示例中。

sents.en: A call to help_func() is inserted immediately after the opening brace of the target function.
sents.zh: 在目标函数的开括符后立即插入对 help_func() 的调用。

sents.en: This transformation introduces an additional benign interprocedural call before the original function logic.
sents.zh: 这种转换会在原始函数逻辑之前引入一个额外的良性过程间调用。

paragraphs.en: These seven transformations correspond directly to tf1–tf7 in Table VIII of the main manuscript.
paragraphs.zh: 这七种转变与主手稿表 VIII 中的 tf1–tf7 直接对应。

paragraphs.en: As reported in the main paper, several baseline encoder models, including CodeBERT, GraphCodeBERT, and UniXcoder, show clear performance drops on the Juliet dataset under different adversarial perturbations. In some cases, their F1 scores decrease to nearly zero. To examine whether these results are caused by evaluation artifacts or pipeline failures, we conduct a sanity check and failure analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 正如主论文所报告的，包括 CodeBERT、GraphCodeBERT 和 UniXcoder 在内的几种基线编码器模型，在 Juliet 数据集上面对不同的对抗性扰动时，性能出现了明显的下降。 在某些情况下，它们的 F1 分数甚至降至接近零。 为了探究这些结果是否由评估中的伪影或流程故障引起，我们进行了合理性检查和故障分析。

sents.en: As reported in the main paper, several baseline encoder models, including CodeBERT, GraphCodeBERT, and UniXcoder, show clear performance drops on the Juliet dataset under different adversarial perturbations.
sents.zh: 正如主论文所报告的，包括 CodeBERT、GraphCodeBERT 和 UniXcoder 在内的几种基线编码器模型，在 Juliet 数据集上面对不同的对抗性扰动时，性能出现了明显的下降。

sents.en: In some cases, their F1 scores decrease to nearly zero.
sents.zh: 在某些情况下，它们的 F1 分数甚至降至接近零。

sents.en: To examine whether these results are caused by evaluation artifacts or pipeline failures, we conduct a sanity check and failure analysis.
sents.zh: 为了探究这些结果是否由评估中的伪影或流程故障引起，我们进行了合理性检查和故障分析。

paragraphs.en: The analysis shows that the near zero F1 scores are mainly caused by tokenization truncation and confidence collapse. Sequence based models usually impose a maximum sequence length, such as 512 tokens. The perturbations increase the code length and cause all perturbed samples in the analyzed subsets to exceed this limit. The average length is more than 860 tokens. As a result, the actual vulnerable lines are truncated and fall outside the input range of the models.
paragraphs.zh: 分析表明，接近零的 F1 分数主要由分词截断和置信度崩溃引起。 基于序列的模型通常会设置最大序列长度，例如 512 个词元。 扰动会增加代码长度，导致所分析子集中所有经过扰动的样本都超出这一限制。 平均长度超过 860 个词元。 因此，实际存在漏洞的代码行被截断，并超出了模型的输入范围。

sents.en: The analysis shows that the near zero F1 scores are mainly caused by tokenization truncation and confidence collapse.
sents.zh: 分析表明，接近零的 F1 分数主要由分词截断和置信度崩溃引起。

sents.en: Sequence based models usually impose a maximum sequence length, such as 512 tokens.
sents.zh: 基于序列的模型通常会设置最大序列长度，例如 512 个词元。

sents.en: The perturbations increase the code length and cause all perturbed samples in the analyzed subsets to exceed this limit.
sents.zh: 扰动会增加代码长度，导致所分析子集中所有经过扰动的样本都超出这一限制。

sents.en: The average length is more than 860 tokens.
sents.zh: 平均长度超过 860 个词元。

sents.en: As a result, the actual vulnerable lines are truncated and fall outside the input range of the models.
sents.zh: 因此，实际存在漏洞的代码行被截断，并超出了模型的输入范围。

paragraphs.en: After the vulnerable lines are truncated, the models lose important semantic information for prediction. As shown in Figure 9 , the predicted probabilities of true vulnerable samples are mostly below the standard 0.5 decision threshold. The models, therefore, classify most samples as benign and produce zero true positives. These results indicate that the zero F1 scores are not caused by evaluation errors. Instead, they reflect the sensitivity of sequence based encoder models to sequence inflation.
paragraphs.zh: 脆弱序列被截断后，模型会丢失预测所需的重要语义信息。 如图 9 所示，真实脆弱样本的预测概率大多低于标准的 0.5 决策阈值。 因此，这些模型将大多数样本分类为良性，且没有产生任何真阳性结果。 这些结果表明，F1 分数为零并非由评估错误所致。 相反，这反映了基于序列的编码器模型对序列膨胀的敏感性。

sents.en: After the vulnerable lines are truncated, the models lose important semantic information for prediction.
sents.zh: 脆弱序列被截断后，模型会丢失预测所需的重要语义信息。

sents.en: As shown in Figure 9 , the predicted probabilities of true vulnerable samples are mostly below the standard 0.5 decision threshold.
sents.zh: 如图 9 所示，真实脆弱样本的预测概率大多低于标准的 0.5 决策阈值。

sents.en: The models, therefore, classify most samples as benign and produce zero true positives.
sents.zh: 因此，这些模型将大多数样本分类为良性，且没有产生任何真阳性结果。

sents.en: These results indicate that the zero F1 scores are not caused by evaluation errors.
sents.zh: 这些结果表明，F1 分数为零并非由评估错误所致。

sents.en: Instead, they reflect the sensitivity of sequence based encoder models to sequence inflation.
sents.zh: 相反，这反映了基于序列的编码器模型对序列膨胀的敏感性。
